recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic live performance shot of a bearded musician in a cowboy hat, set against a dark stage background with a prominent, upward-arched typographic header featuring blue-to-white gradients and sharp, stylized serifs.
coreVisualRelationships: The upward diagonal of the musician's arm leads the eye to the start of the arched text.
The bright white microphone stand provides a vertical counterpoint to the horizontal action.
The blue gradient in the text contrasts with the warm, earthy tones of the musician's skin and clothing.
The dark, textured background isolates the subject and makes the illuminated text pop.
coreInvariants: Arched text path following the top-right quadrant
Low-key stage lighting with a single warm spotlight effect
Musician wearing a dark felt cowboy hat and denim/leather jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The musician is positioned in the lower right, occupying roughly 40% of the frame, with an arm extending toward the left edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized name text in the upper right serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye enters at the musician's face, follows the extended arm to the left, then sweeps upward and right along the arched typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark negative space in the upper left and center provides breathing room for the text and emphasizes the stage setting.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black provide the background and shadow depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and cyan-blue gradients define the typography and highlight areas.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and tan tones appear in the skin, beard, and stage lighting flares.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright text/highlights and the dark background; medium saturation in the blue gradients.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to blues, whites, and warm earth tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with flared, sharp terminals
letterConstructionRules: Letters follow a curved baseline arching upward to the right
Vertical strokes are thick with sharp, wedge-like serifs or spurs
The 'R' and 'W' feature elongated, pointed descenders or flourishes
Internal horizontal bars are thin and high-waisted
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a sharp, dagger-like leg
The 'W' is constructed of two overlapping 'V' shapes with pointed bottoms
The 'Y' has a deep, angular crotch

treatment.fill: vertical gradient from cyan to white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, simpler blocky sans-serif for secondary information, following the same arch.
graphicDevices: Swash flourishes at the beginning of the text line
Lens flare or 'bokeh' circle in the mid-left

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Custom vector lettering based on 'Iron Maiden' or 'Western' styles
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, aggressive but melodic country-rock vibe
Provides the necessary sharp serifs and high-waisted structure

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy 1970s-style concert photo of a male country singer with a beard and cowboy hat, singing into a microphone, arm extended, dark stage background with a warm light flare on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom arched lettering in the top right corner with a cyan-to-white vertical gradient and sharp, pointed serifs.

verificationChecks: Is the text following a clear upward arch?
Does the musician have a 1970s aesthetic?
Is the color gradient in the text visible and smooth?
Is the background sufficiently dark to provide contrast?

adjustableVariables: Color of the gradient (e.g., orange to yellow for a different mood)
mustRedesign: The specific artist name and album title text
Any specific record label logos in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check for '70s era-appropriate clothing and gear
Ensure the text gradient flows vertically within the letters
Verify the composition feels balanced despite the heavy right-side weight
Confirm the typography feels integrated into the scene's perspective
recipe.reuseFormula: Live performance photo + Arched gradient display type + High-contrast stage lighting = 70s Rock Aesthetic
